author: CC
prose: Orchestrator ask, 2026-11-12, from the sail-proof census (ticket 44347787f7d3): 48 production write_text calls carry no newline= (the AST census, excluding proofs; the earlier grep count of 50 was line-based). On Windows each turns a newline into CRLF. Measured by reading each call's reader: none goes through the artifact door (it writes bytes), none is a fingerprinted source or a seal, and almost all are json or jsonl logs in instance-space read by json.loads, which does not care. Two write a SCRIPT that a shell runs or a file compared with a tracked source: tester/reseal.py:959 install_hook copies the pre-commit hook with write_text, so the installed hook is CRLF on Windows and LF on Linux for one tracked source; system_word/probes/his_case_never_bites.py:77 _stub writes bash stubs the dispatcher executes. Git Bash tolerates CRLF today (measured: an if/fi script ran rc 0), so neither is red on this box; they are the two writers whose output is executed, not parsed. The 1163 proof-side calls are not touched; a proof that reds from one gets its own fix (the sail proof did, ticket 44347787f7d3).
